purpose: One removable tag inside an InputTag; the critical variant marks tags past the maximum. Used alone only where a removable tag is needed outside the field.

notFor.case: Standalone use as a filter or label that is not removable.
Entering tags; the chip is a part of the field.

Default.visual: Surface/muted fill with Content/primary label and remove glyph; critical: Status/critical/surface fill, Status/critical/border edge, Status/critical/content ink.

Focused.visual: Border/focus edge with a Border/ring/default halo (critical: Status/critical/border-strong with Status/critical/border).

Disabled.visual: Action/disabled/default fill; label and glyph in Content/disabled.

a11y.role: the remove glyph is a button named "Remove {label}"
a11y.keyboard: Tab reaches the remove button; Enter or Space removes the tag.
notes: Set removeLabel when the label is not text.
Heights are 18 to 32px, so the remove button may sit under the 24px hit area at the smallest sizes.

openQuestions: Hit area: the xs and sm chips are 18 and 20px high. Does the remove button get a 24px hit area beyond the chip, or is it exempt?
Reduced motion: should the edge and halo transitions (use-hover, use-focus) be instant with reduced motion?
Critical: is a critical chip announced as over the limit, or told only by colour?
